title: OpenAI and PwC collaborate to reimagine the office of the CFO
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI and PwC are partnering to help enterprises use AI agents to automate finance workflows, improve forecasting, strengthen controls, and modernize the CFO function....
body:
